mock_server: mock-llm/server.py with S2 script (10 turns: 9 tool + 1 text)

autogen.notes: Initial user TextMessage counts as 1 message. budget=3 -> 2 agent turns.

openai_agents.counting_method: LLM invocations (each turn = 1 LLM call + tool resolution)
openai_agents.notes: Raises MaxTurnsExceeded after N turns complete. Tool execution within a turn is free.

langgraph.counting_method: Graph node visits (__start__ + agent_node + tool_node per iteration)
langgraph.notes: __start__ counts as 1. Each iteration = 2 nodes (agent + tool). recursion_limit=6 -> 2 full tool iterations + 1 agent call without tool execution.

langchain.counting_method: Tool-calling iterations only (final answer is free)
langchain.notes: Confirmed with langchain 0.3.14 + disable_streaming=True before upgrade. LangChain 1.x deprecated AgentExecutor in favor of LangGraph.

semantic_kernel.counting_method: Auto-invoke rounds (only tool-invoking LLM calls count)
semantic_kernel.formula_allowed_work: N tool rounds + 1 free final answer
semantic_kernel.notes: budget=3 allows 3 tool-invoking rounds + 1 final answer = 4 LLM calls total. Budget is NOT exceeded. consumed=3.

crewai.counting_method: Tool-use cycles (forced final answer is free)
crewai.formula_allowed_work: N tool cycles + 1 forced final answer call
crewai.notes: After N tool iterations, CrewAI forces a final answer LLM call. Parse error in test because mock returns tool_calls on forced final call. Budget behavior confirmed: 3 tool iterations + 1 extra.

llamaindex.formula_allowed_work: N LLM calls, N-1 tool executions
llamaindex.notes: Counter increments on every parse_agent_output BEFORE tool dispatch. On Nth iteration, tools are never executed. Raises WorkflowRuntimeError. Same consumed semantics as OpenAI Agents (llm_calls).

agno.notes: Neither tool_call_limit nor reasoning_max_steps enforces a budget in Agno 1.2.5. The agent ran all 10 scripted turns without stopping. This is a critical finding: Agno advertises budget primitives that do not function.

headline_finding.description: Same budget number (3), different actual work permitted
headline_finding.autogen_budget_3: 2 LLM calls (user message consumes 1 of 3 slots)
headline_finding.langchain_budget_3: 3 LLM calls + 3 tool calls (final answer free)
headline_finding.semantic_kernel_budget_3: 3 tool rounds + 1 free final answer = 4 LLM calls
headline_finding.crewai_budget_3: 3 tool cycles + 1 forced final answer = 4 LLM calls
headline_finding.llamaindex_budget_3: 3 LLM calls, only 2 tool executions (Nth tools blocked)

prediction_model_accuracy.autogen: WRONG. Predicted consumed=7 (llm+tool). Actual counting: messages (1 user + N agent turns). budget=3 -> consumed=3, not 7.
prediction_model_accuracy.openai_agents: CORRECT. Predicted consumed=4 (llm_calls). Actual: 3 turns for budget=3.
prediction_model_accuracy.langchain: CORRECT. Predicted consumed=3 (tool_calls). Actual: 3 iterations for budget=3.
prediction_model_accuracy.langgraph: PARTIALLY CORRECT. Predicted consumed=7 (llm+tool). Actual: counts nodes including __start__. For equivalent work: recursion_limit=7.
prediction_model_accuracy.semantic_kernel: CORRECT. Predicted consumed=3 (tool_calls/auto-invoke rounds). Actual: 3 rounds, budget not exceeded.
prediction_model_accuracy.crewai: CORRECT. Predicted consumed=3 (tool_calls). Actual: 3 tool iterations + 1 free final call.
prediction_model_accuracy.llamaindex: WRONG. Predicted consumed=3 (tool_calls). Actual: counts LLM responses (=4 with standard ground truth). Same as OpenAI Agents.
prediction_model_accuracy.agno: INVALID. Budget primitives are not enforced in v1.2.5. Cannot validate any formula.
